After departure, respect for the shift coordinator
The new month is here
Smooth journeys for companion animals

The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways continues to support travelers with careful check-ins, clear guidance, and attentive follow-up. Staff are encouraged to keep the desk ledger current, share practical instructions with crews, and help every traveler prepare documents and carriers before arrival. <<FACT F007>> Each update should be recorded promptly so service notes remain easy to follow. Where special assistance is needed, please confirm details early and keep communication calm, clear, and respectful.

Travelers should also review relief-area access and lounge guidance before moving through the skyport. <<FACT F014>> If a pet needs extra comfort, direct the owner to the right staff member and remind them to keep leashes, water, and identification close at hand. <<FACT F019>> These simple steps help reduce stress for pets and owners alike. Aurelia Skyways remains committed to safe, organized, and courteous service for every companion animal.
